track1: A single woman in a dark blue outfit and black boots stands before one large blue moon against a nearly black background. The moon and cool blue glow occupy the upper background. Photographic music artwork with existing typography.
track2: Two men in sunglasses in front of a cyan studio wall, one in a dark graphic T-shirt and cap, the other in a white T-shirt bearing a printed illustration of a black tote bag. The cyan wall is above their heads and the lower part of the picture contains their clothing. Direct flash photography with existing typography.
track3: A photograph viewed from above of one man sitting on dark asphalt beside the open door of a red sports car. A diagonal metal roadside guardrail separates the road from water. Water occupies the upper left and the top edge; dark asphalt occupies the bottom edge. Sparse vegetation grows beside the guardrail. Muted twilight light and fine photographic grain.
